runs.label: Sep 5–10, 2026 · Test run
runs.headline: New scores on hold
runs.summary: Current public findings are available. Numeric scores were withheld because benchmark rules and analytics could not be refreshed.
runs.hold: No current score was issued. Earlier artifact scores are historical references, and the unequal reporting windows do not support a numeric week-over-week comparison.

recommendations.title: Remove the retreat template from Owners & Developers
recommendations.why: The report found unrelated event, refund, registration, and itinerary content beneath the Industrialized Construction opening.
recommendations.action: Replace the leaked sections with the intended owner-system proof, process, and conversion path. Recheck the full page before promotion.
recommendations.verify: The next review should confirm that every section and call to action serves owners and developers.

recommendations.title: Restore source and analytics access
recommendations.why: The September 10 test could not refresh benchmark rules or access website and YouTube analytics.
recommendations.action: Verify the benchmark agent can read canonical Drive folders, inspect analytics freshness, and write its report to Official Benchmark Runs.
recommendations.verify: The next run records accessible sources, finalized observation windows, and benchmark versions before issuing supported scores.

recommendations.title: Align the persistent positioning
recommendations.why: The homepage and recent LinkedIn content express the IC systems proposition, while older pages and profiles retain broader legacy positioning.
recommendations.action: Clarify how Industrialized Construction relates to ADL’s venture, climate-tech, accelerator, and government work. Apply the resulting language across persistent profiles.
recommendations.verify: Reassess the same surfaces against Strategy Marketing Consistency v1.0.

recommendations.title: Reconcile proof points and office details
recommendations.why: Portfolio and Accelerators cite $510M and $600M without clear definitions and dates; public office details appear inconsistent.
recommendations.action: Add source links, population definitions, and as-of dates to claims. Verify all locations against the authoritative listing.
recommendations.verify: Material claims have traceable evidence, and public office information agrees.

recommendations.title: Complete a copy and production pass
recommendations.why: The report identified a missing preposition, an Industrialized Construction misspelling, and stale footer years.
recommendations.action: Correct the homepage sentence, ROAD to IC spelling, footer years, and unresolved placeholders on controlled program pages.
recommendations.verify: Recheck published pages and record the evidence of each correction.

recommendations.title: Confirm the YouTube measurement path
recommendations.why: Official channel ownership and activity were unverified in the report.
recommendations.action: Record the official channel URL in the inventory and use the authorized YouTube dataset for activity and engagement.
recommendations.verify: A future report links the owned channel and cites dated analytics; search visibility alone does not establish inactivity.

runs.coverageNote: Inventory completeness was not verified in this test.
runs.analyticsNote: Website and YouTube data unavailable to the report agent.
